title: uvaria gilva
intro: Uvaria gilva, commonly known as the Yellow Wood Apple, is a plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Uvaria gilva include its ability to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its antipyretic and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Uvaria gilva include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
